title: 助手
summary: 助手不是默认整页聊天。先定它住在对话、侧栏、插件、浮层、画布，还是看不见。
summaryEn: The assistant is not a default full-page chat. First decide whether it lives in chat, a side panel, a plugin, a float, a canvas, or nowhere visible.
asks: 助手住在对话、侧栏、插件、浮层、画布，还是看不见？
asksEn: Does the assistant live in chat, a side panel, a plugin, a float, a canvas, or nowhere visible?

links.when: 助手住哪不是整页骨架
